title: Noy and Zhang Experimental evidence on productivity effects
finding: Randomized professional writing task experiment supports task-level capability gains.
limit: Does not establish complete textile workflow performance or societal transformation.

title: Brynjolfsson Li and Raymond Generative AI at Work published version
finding: Customer-support field evidence supports measurable workplace capability benefits.
limit: One studied workplace setting; heterogeneous effects; not society-wide evidence.

title: Humlum and Vestergaard author report of Still waters rapid currents
finding: Authors report no detectable average earnings or recorded-hours effect in their Danish study, despite changes in tasks.
limit: Original researcher account, not a substitute for full methods review; direct NBER page retrieval failed. Country and observation window limit generalization. Does not rule out future transformation.

title: NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile
finding: Official guidance identifies confabulation and recommends contextual evaluation and source verification.
limit: Risk framework, not evidence of the frequency of errors in this proposed workflow.

title: Lewis et al Retrieval Augmented Generation
finding: Original RAG work combines a retriever and generator for knowledge-intensive tasks.
limit: Does not demonstrate Canva mockups or eliminate source and generation errors.
